caption: The drawing shows a full-length, off-the-shoulder dress with short, loose sleeves. The main dress is rendered in a light, almost pastel green hue, and the fabric has thin, horizontal lines and a pattern of small, reddish-brown dots throughout. The bodice is fitted, tapering to a point at the waist, with vertical lines suggesting gathering or pleats. The sleeves are transparent, with a green band near the top, decorated with a dark green criss-cross or diamond pattern, and contain pink floral details near the lower edge. The lower edge of the sleeves is trimmed with white ruffles. The skirt is very full and gathered at the waist, with vertical stripes created by the folds of the fabric. In the upper right of the drawing is a smaller, monochrome line sketch of the same dress, shown from the back, which includes the same distinctive sleeves and full skirt. The drawing is presented on a plain beige background.
title: Dress
